_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-03, BEFORE any signal was computed or any result existed (SPY and QQQ OHLC were downloaded for the overnight test, which is a different rule). Do not edit to fit a result. To change a criterion, add a dated entry to docs/research/log.md saying why, then edit.
idea: Low-exposure mean reversion on index ETFs: buy short-term weakness inside an uptrend (RSI(2), Connors) or a close near the bottom of the day's range (internal bar strength), exit on a bounce. Evidence is thin and mostly vendor-grade: one analysis finds Sharpe 0.97 before the book was published and 0.68 after, below buy and hold; no independent post-cost, rolling out-of-sample test found. Expectation stated up front: a small positive Sharpe that does not beat buy and hold. See docs/research/swing-trading-research.md section 2B.

rsi2.signal_at_close: RSI(2), Wilder smoothing (seeded with the simple average of the first 2 changes). Flat to long when close > SMA(200) and RSI(2) < 10. Long to flat when close > SMA(5).

ibs.signal_at_close: IBS = (close - low) / (high - low). Flat to long when IBS < 0.2. Long to flat when IBS > 0.8. No trend filter.

rules.common: Long or flat only, all of equity in whole shares, cash idle at 0. No shorting, no stops, no parameter other than those listed.

fills.primary: signal decided from data through day t's close, filled at day t+1's OPEN (a market-on-open order). This is what a retail trader can actually do.
fills.reference_only: filled at day t's close (the literature's usual assumption). Reported to show how much of any result depends on an unachievable fill; it is NOT a pass criterion.

prices: IBKR daily bars, ADJUSTED_LAST. Today's unfinished bar dropped.
costs: tempo.backtest.Costs commission and the SEC fee on sells, plus slippage in bps per side; base 1 bp, sweep 0, 1, 3, 5, 10

variants_tried.note: Only the primary can pass criteria 1 to 7. All four are reported.

negative_control: 200 versions in which the order of days is shuffled as whole bars (gap, high, low and close of each day relative to the previous close travel together): keeps each day's shape and the return distribution, destroys serial structure, which is what mean reversion needs.
reported_not_criteria: number of round trips and average net return per trip
pass_all_of: primary net Sharpe at 1 bp per side (next-open fills) >= SPY buy-and-hold Sharpe over the same days
primary net CAGR > 0 at 3 bps per side
primary net CAGR > 0 at 1 bp in both halves of the sample
primary post-2010 part alone: net CAGR > 0 and net Sharpe >= 0.4 at 1 bp
t-statistic of the primary's mean daily net return at 1 bp > 3.0 (Harvey, Liu, Zhu)
primary max drawdown shallower than SPY buy and hold
primary beats at least 95% of the 200 shuffled-bar controls on net Sharpe
at least 3 of the 4 variants have net CAGR > 0 at 3 bps per side
if_fail: Report it as a failure, with the break-even slippage and the same-close reference. No extra variants, no parameter changes, no filters added afterwards.
if_pass: Still not proof of an edge and not real money: next step is a fill-and-slippage log on the paper account using market-on-open orders through tempo/orders.py.
